{"id":"R4-3","status":"fixed","summary":"The finding is real. The Pos bump keyframes (`50% { scale(1.12) }` with implicit 0% and 100% at rest) ran the stamp easing twice. In Chromium the panel overshot to about ×1.13 on the way up and dipped below rest on the way down. The new test measured a peak of 1.12959 before the fix.

The suggested fix (a per-keyframe animation-timing-function of var(--ease-snap)) could not be used, for two reasons:
1. Chromium ignores var() in a keyframe's timing function. getKeyframes() still reported the stamp curve on every keyframe.
2. The existing tests/ui/source-rules.test.ts only allows transform, box-shadow, clip-path and visibility inside @keyframes.

Instead, in src/ui/hud.css, ui-hud-bump and ui-hud-bump-again are now landings, the same shape as the lap stamp: `from { transform: scale(var(--ui-hud-bump)); }`. The panel starts at ×1.12 and lands at rest on the stamp easing, so it overshoots only once, on the landing (UI_RULES §7). Trade-off: the panel now jumps straight to ×1.12 instead of growing into it. The element rule is unchanged (0.16s, stamp), so AC1 still holds, and only tokens are used.

New test tests/ui/hud-motion-bump-overshoot.test.ts renders the overtake stage in Chromium, pauses the Pos panel's animation and samples its scale every 2 ms. It checks that the peak is ×1.12, never more, and that the scale leaves [1, 1.12] at most once. It failed before the fix (1.1296) and passes after. pnpm typecheck is clean; pnpm test passes (112 files, 741 tests).","tests":["tests/ui/hud-motion-bump-overshoot.test.ts"]}

structured_output.summary:
The finding is real. The Pos bump keyframes (`50% { scale(1.12) }` with implicit 0% and 100% at rest) ran the stamp easing twice. In Chromium the panel overshot to about ×1.13 on the way up and dipped below rest on the way down. The new test measured a peak of 1.12959 before the fix.

The suggested fix (a per-keyframe animation-timing-function of var(--ease-snap)) could not be used, for two reasons:
1. Chromium ignores var() in a keyframe's timing function. getKeyframes() still reported the stamp curve on every keyframe.
2. The existing tests/ui/source-rules.test.ts only allows transform, box-shadow, clip-path and visibility inside @keyframes.

Instead, in src/ui/hud.css, ui-hud-bump and ui-hud-bump-again are now landings, the same shape as the lap stamp: `from { transform: scale(var(--ui-hud-bump)); }`. The panel starts at ×1.12 and lands at rest on the stamp easing, so it overshoots only once, on the landing (UI_RULES §7). Trade-off: the panel now jumps straight to ×1.12 instead of growing into it. The element rule is unchanged (0.16s, stamp), so AC1 still holds, and only tokens are used.

New test tests/ui/hud-motion-bump-overshoot.test.ts renders the overtake stage in Chromium, pauses the Pos panel's animation and samples its scale every 2 ms. It checks that the peak is ×1.12, never more, and that the scale leaves [1, 1.12] at most once. It failed before the fix (1.1296) and passes after. pnpm typecheck is clean; pnpm test passes (112 files, 741 tests).
